Gideon, your first report of the kiosks offline on 3 Aug was at **10:42 AM** in #inc-vtg-hartford. It described both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel records little about the guard in the meantime. Your 10:42 message says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Nothing else in the channel covers the guard's activity between those two points.
